display.purpose: First half of a headline pair: Inter 300 drawn as a 1px cream stroke, transparent fill.

display-italic.purpose: Second half of the pair: Cormorant italic 400 filled gold.

title.purpose: Service row names, ledger terms, FAQ questions, step names.

accent.purpose: Finish label, estimated total, instructions, group headings, closing notes.

body-long.purpose: Answers and descriptions in cream-70, capped at 60-62ch.

label.purpose: Nav links, ruler ticks, day counts, field labels, meta, captions; uppercase, tracked.

motion.name: ease-heavy
motion.purpose: Movement: schedule bars, finish flag, button fill wipe, send bar, FAQ plus rotation (0.9-1.1s).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Hover colour changes, dock fade, menu and FAQ entrances (0.6-0.9s).

motion.name: scroll-scrub
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger timeline with Lenis smooth scroll; power1/power2 inOut eases
motion.purpose: Pinned hero and project ring choreography: clip-path wipes, opacity cross-fades, 3D transforms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: no pin, no ring (horizontal snap gallery instead), wire layers hidden, gold layers shown, transitions at 0.01ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Outlined gold action; a gold fill wipes in from the left on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; padding: 19px 40px; border: 1px solid var(--gold, #c9ab70); border-radius: 0; background: none; color: var(--gold, #c9ab70); font: 400 0.75rem/1 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--gold, #c9ab70); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-btn:hover, .ds-btn:focus-visible { color: var(--ink, #0f0f0d); } .ds-btn:hover::before, .ds-btn:focus-visible::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--gold, #c9ab70); outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Secondary action: underlined tracked label that turns gold.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { padding: 10px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: rgb(239 233 220 / 0.7); font: 400 0.6875rem/1.4 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.26em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 6px; text-decoration-color: rgb(239 233 220 / 0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-text:hover { color: #c9ab70; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c9ab70; outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Label above, underline only; gold on focus, dashed gold when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field__label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font: 400 0.6875rem/1.4 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.26em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(239 233 220 / 0.55); } .ds-field__input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 14px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(239 233 220 / 0.3); border-radius: 0; background: none; color: #efe9dc; font: 300 1.1875rem/1.6 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: #c9ab70; transition: border-color 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #c9ab70; } .ds-field__input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-bottom: 1px dashed #c9ab70; }

components.name: Docked Header
components.description: Fixed ink bar with tracked wordmark and label links; current section in gold.
components.html:
KNC Studio

components.css: .ds-dock { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 clamp(20px, 4vw, 56px); background: #0f0f0d; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(239 233 220 / 0.12); color: #efe9dc; } .ds-dock__mark { font: 400 0.8125rem/1 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.36em; color: #efe9dc; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dock__links { display: flex; gap: 36px; } .ds-dock__links a { font: 400 0.6875rem/1.4 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.26em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #efe9dc; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-dock__links a:hover, .ds-dock__links a[aria-current] { color: #c9ab70; } .ds-dock__links a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c9ab70; outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Plan Chip
components.description: Square gold-45 outline for a chosen service; dashed gold for a visitor's own idea.
components.html:
• Temel kurulum
  • Randevu takvimi
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-chip { padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(201 171 112 / 0.45); color: #efe9dc; font: 300 0.875rem/1.3 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip--idea { border-style: dashed; color: #c9ab70; }

components.name: Schedule Row
components.description: Signature planner row: checkbox, serif name, day range, and a gold bar (chosen) or dashed ghost (not yet) on the week track.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42% 1fr; column-gap: 48px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(239 233 220 / 0.12); } .ds-row__pick { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row__box { flex: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(239 233 220 / 0.55); transition: background-color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row__name { font: 300 1.75rem/1.15 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Times New Roman', serif; color: rgb(239 233 220 / 0.7); transition: color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row__pick:hover .ds-row__name, .ds-row.is-on .ds-row__name { color: #efe9dc; } .ds-row__days { margin-left: auto; white-space: nowrap; font: 400 0.6875rem/1 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(239 233 220 / 0.55); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row.is-on .ds-row__box { background: #c9ab70; border-color: #c9ab70; } .ds-row.is-on .ds-row__days { color: #c9ab70; } .ds-row__track { position: relative; height: 16px; } .ds-row__bar { position: absolute; left: 50%; width: 12%; top: 5px; height: 6px; background: #c9ab70; transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-row__ghost { position: absolute; left: 50%; width: 22%; top: 7px; border-top: 1px dashed rgb(239 233 220 / 0.3); } .ds-row__pick:hover ~ .ds-row__track .ds-row__ghost { border-top-color: #c9ab70; }

components.name: FAQ Item
components.description: Disclosure row between hairlines; serif question turns gold, SVG plus turns into a cross.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid rgb(239 233 220 / 0.12); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(239 233 220 / 0.12); color: #efe9dc; } .ds-faq summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 24px 0; font: 300 2rem/1.2 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Times New Roman', serif; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary:hover, .ds-faq[open] summary { color: #c9ab70; } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c9ab70; outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-faq svg { flex: none; width: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.2; transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-faq[open] svg { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq p { max-width: 60ch; margin: 0; padding-bottom: 28px; color: rgb(239 233 220 / 0.7); font: 300 1.0625rem/1.75 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Headline Pair
components.description: Outlined Inter phrase answered by a filled gold Cormorant italic phrase.
components.html: Bir fikir, çalışan bir ürün.
components.css: .ds-pair { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 8vw, 6rem); line-height: 1.02; font-weight: 300; } .ds-pair__a { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #efe9dc; } .ds-pair__b { font: italic 400 1.1em/1.02 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Times New Roman', serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #c9ab70; }

narrative.overview:
The site opens as a wireframe: dashed boxes for a nav, a dashed frame crossed by dashed diagonals, an outlined sans headline. Scrolling turns the drawing into the built thing, line by line: dashed strokes are wiped away as solid gold strokes sweep in behind them, the gold serif half of the headline fills left to right, and the frame fills with warm brown. That sentence, "not yet" becoming "built", is the grammar of the whole system, and it is reused everywhere after the hero: the planner's unchosen services preview as dashed ghost bars and chosen ones draw as solid gold bars; an idea row has a dashed box; an invalid field gets a dashed underline; a chip for a free-text idea is dashed.

The ground is near-black and quiet. Density is low: one message per screen, very large type set light, hairline rules instead of boxes, generous vertical air between sections. Gold is never decoration for its own sake; it means chosen, built, current or actionable. Motion is slow and heavy, scrubbed to scroll in the pinned opening and eased on a heavy in-out curve elsewhere.

There are no gradients, no shadows, no rounded corners and no filled card grids. Depth comes from the 3D project ring and from the single warm surface tone.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, cream text, one muted gold for state, one warm brown for filled surfaces.
Dashed hairline = not yet; solid gold = chosen or built.
Outlined sans phrase answered by a filled gold italic serif phrase.
Square corners everywhere; the only circle is the timeline dot.
Hairline rules (1px) organise content; containers are rare.
Slow, heavy easing; scroll-scrubbed choreography in the pinned opening.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only hue. A new state, highlight or call to action is expressed in gold or in a cream tint, never in a new colour.

rules.name: The Gold Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: Gold marks something selected, built, current or actionable. If an element is none of those, it is cream.

rules.name: The Flat Fill Rule
rules.body: No gradients anywhere. Surfaces are a single flat tone: ink or warm.

rules.name: The Outline Then Fill Rule
rules.body: A headline pair is an outlined Inter phrase followed by a filled gold Cormorant italic phrase. The outline is the plan; the gold italic is what was made. Use it for the opening statement of a scene, not for every title.

rules.name: The Serif Holds The Number Rule
rules.body: Durations, totals and names that a visitor will remember are set in the serif; the sans only labels and explains.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. Separation is a hairline or a change from ink to warm.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Not Yet Rule
rules.body: A dashed stroke marks something unbuilt, unchosen, unsized or unconfirmed. When it becomes real it turns solid, and usually gold. Never dash a finished element for texture.

dos: Do express every "not yet / now chosen" change as dashed cream-30 becoming solid gold.
Do pair an outlined Inter 300 phrase with a filled gold Cormorant italic phrase for the opening statement of a scene.
Do keep corners square and lines at 1px; use the warm tone for the few filled surfaces.
Do set names, durations and totals in Cormorant Garamond; keep labels at 0.6875rem, uppercase, tracked 0.2em to 0.28em.

Do choreograph with transform, opacity and clip-path, on the heavy ease (cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)) for movement and the soft out-ease (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for hover colour, at 0.6s to 1.1s.
Do give every scroll-driven scene a finished, static reduced-motion state: no pin, no 3D, every wireframe layer hidden and every gold layer shown.
Do draw icons as thin SVG strokes (1.2) in currentColor or cream-55.
donts: Don't use gradients, shadows or rounded corners.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or a brighter gold.
Don't dash a finished element, or draw a chosen element dashed.
Don't use bounce, spring or elastic easing, or short snappy durations.
Don't fill containers with boxed cards; separate content with hairlines.
